title: Against Overwhelming Numbers
front_description: Mace Windu, Obi-Wan, Anakin, Padmé and an exhausted group of Jedi stand in the center of the arena, by a ring of battle droids. The sand around them is strewn with the bodies of dead Geonosians, shattered droids and fallen Jedi. "You have fought gallantly," Count Dooku calls out from the archducal box. "Now it is finished. Surrender-and your live will spared."
back_description: A model by John Duncan of the new, more powerful super battle droids.
